sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fuinjutsu, Earth Release, Wind Release.

system.description:
You gather a great volume of dust particles and compress it into a high-density shape, before launching it at a creature within range.

Select a Creature, or a space you can see within range, as you drop this massive structure onto it.

If you are targeting a creature, make a ranged ninjutsu attack, dealing 8d10 earth damage and landing on top of the target.

If you are selecting a space then the space is damaged beyond repair, destroying the ground. If the surface is not at least 5 feet thick, then the ground collapses into whatever lies below, and the structure falls to the next surface landing and occupying a 15-feet wide, 20-feet tall cube like space. All creatures within 40-feet of the structure when it lands, must make a Strength saving throw, if they are wielding a metallic weapon. On a failed save, the weapon is drawn to the structure and merged into it for the duration. If a creature hit by this jutsu’s attack fails their strength saving throw to retain their weapon they are also Restrained by being under the structure. A restrained creature remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, escaping from under the structure on a success.

The Structure remains solid and does not fall apart for the duration. Weapons merged into the structure fall harmlessly into a space that can hold it when this jutsu ends.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d10, and the number of structures/attacks you can make by +1.
